\[ 2(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + ab - bc - ac). \]

\[ E = \frac{2(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + ab - bc - ac)}{b^2}. \]

\[ E = \frac{2a^2}{b^2} + \frac{2b^2}{b^2} + \frac{2c^2}{b^2} + \frac{2ab}{b^2} - \frac{2bc}{b^2} - \frac{2ac}{b^2} = \frac{2a^2}{b^2} + 2 + \frac{2c^2}{b^2} + \frac{2a}{b} - \frac{2c}{b} - \frac{2a}{b}. \]
